text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: With this... I can finally face Brian-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Why?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch...!
Getting worn out by just this again...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Jeez. It kinda feels like Maya isn't even on your radar.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Honestly, Brian... where are you even looking...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Where is Brian-san
looking, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan, you know what?
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Just one more time, as soon as possible...
I want to race against Brian-san.
choice_data_list: But you won this time, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it has to be.
...I don't really know why, though.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It just felt like... I had to hurry...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
! Mayano... Is that
what this race made you realize?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then all the more reason
I can't just leave you like this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —The Arima Kinen will surely be her last.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's planning to make the Arima her 'last' race,
and hang up her running shoes after that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Tch... It's way too early for the curtain call...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Why? That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way it's over...
I mean, Brian-san was so strong today too."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"To say it's already over...
No... I don't want to accept that!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Even if I won the race, I still don't feel like I really beat Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It shouldn't just be Maya; I want
that person to get thrilled by Maya too!
choice_data_list: You want to excite that person?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I do. Because it's frustrating, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling Umamusume make the hearts of everyone flutter—
both the rivals running beside them and the spectators watching.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Then Maya wants to be someone who can make that person thrilled too...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-chan. You know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Hishi Ama-san, you said the Arima Kinen would be Brian-san's last, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to get Maya into
perfect shape by the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks.
Ehehe, I'm counting on you.

—If we aim for the Arima Kinen
while arranging a GⅠ rotation full of the strong rivals she seeks...

"At least once in the summer, and once in the autumn.
You should enter mid-to-long or medium distance GⅠ races that prepare you for the Arima."
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen, the Autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then Maya will enter that one.
I'll run in races... and get stronger at top speed.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Because I feel like... that's what I have to do.
